<Window xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
        xmlns:vm="using:Klippy.ViewModels"
        xmlns:views="using:Klippy.Views"
        mc:Ignorable="d" d:DesignWidth="680" d:DesignHeight="560"
        x:Class="Klippy.Views.MainWindow"
        x:DataType="vm:MainViewModel"
        Icon="/Assets/klippy.ico"
        Title="Klippy"
        Width="680" Height="560"
        MinWidth="460" MinHeight="360"
        Background="{StaticResource AppBgBrush}"
        ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint="True"
        ExtendClientAreaTitleBarHeightHint="34"
        FontFamily="{StaticResource FontUi}"
        Foreground="{StaticResource TextPrimaryBrush}">

  <Panel>
    <DockPanel>

      <!-- Titlebar strip (client area extends into it; centered title like the mock) -->
      <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Height="34" IsHitTestVisible="False">
        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center">
          <TextBlock Text="Klippy" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                     Foreground="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                     VerticalAlignment="Center" />
          <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
                     Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                     Text="{Binding VersionText}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
        </StackPanel>
      </Border>

      <!-- Footer: key hints + export/import + count -->
      <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="14,8"
              BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
        <DockPanel>
          <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="12">
            <Button Classes="footerLink" Classes.on="{Binding IsPreviewOpen}"
                    Content="preview" Focusable="False"
                    Command="{Binding TogglePreviewCommand}" />
            <Button Classes="footerLink" Content="clear history"
                    IsVisible="{Binding IsHistoryMode}"
                    Command="{Binding ClearHistoryCommand}" />
            <Button Classes="footerLink" Content="export / import"
                    Command="{Binding OpenTransferCommand}" />
            <Button Classes="footerLink" Content="settings"
                    Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}" />
            <Button Classes="footerLink" Content="quit"
                    Command="{Binding RequestQuitCommand}" />
            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                       Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                       Text="{Binding SnippetCountText}" />
          </StackPanel>
          <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
                     Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                     Text="{Binding KeyHints}" />
        </DockPanel>
      </Border>

      <!-- Filter bar -->
      <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="14,12"
              BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
        <DockPanel>
          <Button DockPanel.Dock="Right" Classes="primary" Margin="10,0,0,0"
                  Command="{Binding NewCommand}">
            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
              <TextBlock Text="+" FontSize="14" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,-1,0,0" />
              <TextBlock Text="New" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
            </StackPanel>
          </Button>
          <Border Background="{StaticResource SurfaceBrush}"
                  BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderStrongBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                  CornerRadius="6" Padding="10,7">
            <DockPanel>
              <Viewbox DockPanel.Dock="Left" Width="13" Height="13" Margin="0,0,8,0"
                       VerticalAlignment="Center">
                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconSearch}" Stroke="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                        StrokeThickness="2.4" StrokeLineCap="Round" />
                </Grid>
              </Viewbox>
              <Border DockPanel.Dock="Right" BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderStrongBrush}"
                      BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4" Padding="5,1"
                      VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="8,0,0,0">
                <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
                           Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                           Text="{Binding SearchKeyHint}" />
              </Border>
              <TextBox x:Name="SearchBox" Classes="bare" FontSize="12"
                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                       Watermark="{Binding SearchWatermark}"
                       Text="{Binding FilterText}" />
            </DockPanel>
          </Border>
        </DockPanel>
      </Border>

      <!-- Everything below the filter bar, with the recent-commands list overlaying the
           top of it: the MRU hangs from the search box, so it covers the list rather
           than pushing it down the window every time it opens. -->
      <Panel>
        <DockPanel>

          <!-- Tag chips -->
          <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="14,10"
                  BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
            <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding Tags}">
              <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                  <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6" />
                </ItemsPanelTemplate>
              </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
              <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:TagChipViewModel">
                  <!-- The History chip carries the "mode" class, which sets it apart so the
                       row reads as "mode, then tags" rather than one list of filters. -->
                  <Button Classes="chip" Classes.selected="{Binding IsSelected}"
                          Classes.mode="{Binding IsMode}"
                          Content="{Binding Name}"
                          Command="{Binding $parent[ItemsControl].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).SelectTagCommand}"
                          CommandParameter="{Binding}" />
                </DataTemplate>
              </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
            </ItemsControl>
          </Border>

          <!-- Unmatched search: offers to run what was typed, standing where the first row
               would have been — one band per offer, since a name defined twice in the
               variables file is two places to go. They and the list are one column to the
               arrow keys, and whichever holds the selection wears the bar and the badge. -->
          <ItemsControl x:Name="OfferList" DockPanel.Dock="Top"
                        ItemsSource="{Binding Offers}"
                        IsVisible="{Binding HasOffers}">
            <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
              <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:OfferViewModel">
                <Border Classes="offer" Classes.selected="{Binding IsSelected}"
                        BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
                  <DockPanel>
                    <!-- The same 2px bar the list rows carry, so which of the two Enter is
                         about to act on is answered the same way in both places. -->
                    <Rectangle Classes="selBar" DockPanel.Dock="Left" Width="2" />
                    <Button Classes="offerRow"
                            Command="{Binding $parent[ItemsControl].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).RunOfferCommand}"
                            CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                      <DockPanel>
                        <!-- Play for everything that starts something; the power symbol for
                             the one offer that closes something instead. -->
                        <Viewbox DockPanel.Dock="Left" Width="11" Height="11"
                                 VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0">
                          <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                            <Path Data="{StaticResource IconPlay}" Fill="{StaticResource AccentBrush}"
                                  IsVisible="{Binding !IsQuit}" />
                            <Path Data="{StaticResource IconPower}" Stroke="{StaticResource AccentBrush}"
                                  StrokeThickness="2.2" StrokeLineCap="Round"
                                  IsVisible="{Binding IsQuit}" />
                          </Grid>
                        </Viewbox>
                        <!-- The keys that run it, with more than one band to choose between:
                             outermost, so the numbers line up whichever band wears the badge. -->
                        <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Right" Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="10,0,0,0"
                                   Foreground="{StaticResource Muted2Brush}"
                                   Text="{Binding NumberHint}" IsVisible="{Binding HasNumber}" />
                        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Right" Classes="enterBadge"
                                BorderBrush="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                                CornerRadius="4" Padding="6,1" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                Margin="10,0,0,0">
                          <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
                                     Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}"
                                     Text="{Binding KeyBadge}" />
                        </Border>
                        <TextBlock Classes="offerVerb" DockPanel.Dock="Left" FontSize="12"
                                   FontWeight="SemiBold" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   Margin="0,0,10,0" Text="{Binding Verb}" />
                        <TextBlock Classes="offerDetail mono" FontSize="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   Text="{Binding Detail}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                      </DockPanel>
                    </Button>
                  </DockPanel>
                </Border>
              </DataTemplate>
            </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
          </ItemsControl>

          <!-- List over preview, with a draggable splitter between them. A Grid (not the
               outer DockPanel) because only a Grid can host a GridSplitter. The preview
               row's height is driven from code-behind: 0 when closed, the last dragged
               height when open. -->
          <Grid x:Name="ListPreviewGrid">
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
              <RowDefinition Height="*" MinHeight="72" />
              <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />
              <!-- preview row: height owned by the code-behind (PreviewRowIndex) -->
              <RowDefinition Height="0" />
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <!-- Snippet list -->
            <ListBox x:Name="SnippetList" Grid.Row="0" Classes="snips desktop"
                     ItemsSource="{Binding Filtered}"
                     SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedSnippet}"
                     AutoScrollToSelectedItem="True"
                     SelectionMode="Single">
              <!-- Two row shapes, picked by the item's type: saved snippets carry a
                   quick-code and a tag, captured clips an age and a source app. -->
              <ListBox.DataTemplates>
                <DataTemplate DataType="vm:SnippetViewModel" x:DataType="vm:SnippetViewModel">
                  <Border BorderBrush="{StaticResource RowDividerBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1"
                          Background="Transparent" Tapped="RowTapped">
                    <DockPanel>
                      <Rectangle Classes="selBar" DockPanel.Dock="Left" Width="2" />
                      <Border Classes="rowSurface" Padding="12,9,14,9">
                        <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,Auto" ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">

                          <!-- label + one-line preview -->
                          <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center" Spacing="1">
                            <TextBlock Classes="rowLabel" FontSize="12" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                       Text="{Binding Label}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                            <TextBlock Classes="rowPreview mono" FontSize="11"
                                       Text="{Binding Preview}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                       IsVisible="{Binding !IsExpanded}" />
                          </StackPanel>

                          <!-- trailing: quick-code, tag, chevron, copy glyph / enter badge -->
                          <StackPanel Classes="trailing" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1"
                                      Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="12" Margin="12,0,0,0"
                                      VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <!-- what Enter will do, said on the row rather than found out
                                 by pressing it -->
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" Text="{Binding RunMarker}"
                                       IsVisible="{Binding IsExecutable}" />
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource Muted2Brush}" Text="md"
                                       IsVisible="{Binding IsMarkdown}" />
                            <!-- the keys that trigger it, in Klippy and from anywhere -->
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource Muted2Brush}" Text="{Binding KeysHint}"
                                       IsVisible="{Binding HasKeys}" />
                            <Border BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderStrongBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                                    CornerRadius="4" Padding="5,1" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                    IsVisible="{Binding HasQuickCode}">
                              <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
                                         Foreground="{StaticResource Muted2Brush}"
                                         Text="{Binding QuickCode}" />
                            </Border>
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource Muted2Brush}" Text="{Binding Tag}" />
                            <Button Classes="icon ghost" IsVisible="{Binding IsMultiline}"
                                    Command="{Binding ToggleExpandCommand}">
                              <Viewbox Width="11" Height="11">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconChevronDown}"
                                        Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}" StrokeThickness="2.4"
                                        StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                                        IsVisible="{Binding !IsExpanded}" />
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconChevronUp}"
                                        Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}" StrokeThickness="2.4"
                                        StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                                        IsVisible="{Binding IsExpanded}" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <Viewbox Width="13" Height="13" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                              <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                <Path Classes="copyGlyph" Data="{StaticResource IconCopy}"
                                      Stroke="{StaticResource MutedBrush}" StrokeThickness="2"
                                      StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                              </Grid>
                            </Viewbox>
                            <Border Classes="enterBadge"
                                    BorderBrush="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                                    CornerRadius="4" Padding="6,1" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                              <!-- one badge rather than two, so a row that cannot be run is
                                   not left with the gap where a second one would have sat -->
                              <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
                                         Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}"
                                         Text="{Binding EnterHint}" />
                            </Border>
                          </StackPanel>

                          <!-- hover: edit / duplicate / delete / show / copy buttons -->
                          <StackPanel Classes="hoverActions" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1"
                                      Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4" Margin="12,0,0,0"
                                      VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <Button Classes="icon"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).EditCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconPencil}" Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <Button Classes="icon"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).DuplicateCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconDuplicate}" Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <Button Classes="icon"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).RequestDeleteCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconTrash}" Stroke="{StaticResource DangerBrush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <!-- where the path it names is, marked or not: showing it runs nothing -->
                            <Button Classes="icon" IsVisible="{Binding NamesAPath}"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).RevealCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconFolder}" Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <!-- a marked row still has its text; this is how you get it -->
                            <Button Classes="icon" IsVisible="{Binding IsExecutable}"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).CopyCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconCopy}" Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <!-- the primary action is whatever the item is marked for, so the
                                 glyph follows the marker rather than naming a second gesture -->
                            <Button Classes="icon amber"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).ActivateCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconCopy}" Stroke="{StaticResource OnAccentBrush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2.2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                                        IsVisible="{Binding !IsExecutable}" />
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconPlay}" Stroke="{StaticResource OnAccentBrush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2.2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                                        IsVisible="{Binding IsExecutable}" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                          </StackPanel>

                          <!-- expanded multi-line content -->
                          <Border Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="0" Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                                  IsVisible="{Binding IsExpanded}" Margin="0,7,0,0"
                                  Background="{StaticResource CodeBgBrush}"
                                  BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                                  CornerRadius="6" Padding="11,9">
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="11" LineHeight="17.6"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                       Text="{Binding Content}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                          </Border>
                        </Grid>
                      </Border>
                    </DockPanel>
                  </Border>
                </DataTemplate>

                <!-- Captured clip -->
                <DataTemplate DataType="vm:ClipViewModel" x:DataType="vm:ClipViewModel">
                  <Border BorderBrush="{StaticResource RowDividerBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1"
                          Background="Transparent" Tapped="RowTapped">
                    <DockPanel>
                      <Rectangle Classes="selBar" DockPanel.Dock="Left" Width="2" />
                      <Border Classes="rowSurface" Padding="12,9,14,9">
                        <Grid RowDefinitions="Auto,Auto" ColumnDefinitions="*,Auto">

                          <!-- A clip has no name of its own: its label already *is* the first
                               line, so a preview line underneath would only repeat it. The
                               chevron is what offers the rest of a multi-line clip. An image
                               row leads with a thumbnail, since a size alone identifies nothing. -->
                          <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" Orientation="Horizontal"
                                      Spacing="10" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <Border IsVisible="{Binding IsImage}"
                                    Background="{StaticResource CodeBgBrush}"
                                    BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                                    CornerRadius="4" Padding="1" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                              <Image Source="{Binding Thumbnail}" Height="26" MaxWidth="48"
                                     Stretch="Uniform" />
                            </Border>
                            <Viewbox Width="13" Height="13" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                     IsVisible="{Binding IsFiles}">
                              <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                <Path Data="{StaticResource IconFiles}" Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                      StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                              </Grid>
                            </Viewbox>
                            <TextBlock Classes="rowPreview mono" FontSize="12"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Text="{Binding Label}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                          </StackPanel>

                          <!-- trailing: pin, kind marker, source app, age, chevron, copy -->
                          <StackPanel Classes="trailing" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1"
                                      Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="12" Margin="12,0,0,0"
                                      VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <Viewbox Width="11" Height="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                     IsVisible="{Binding IsPinned}">
                              <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                <Path Data="{StaticResource IconPin}" Stroke="{StaticResource AccentBrush}"
                                      StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                              </Grid>
                            </Viewbox>
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource Muted2Brush}" Text="html"
                                       IsVisible="{Binding HasHtml}" />
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource Muted2Brush}"
                                       Text="{Binding KindMarker}"
                                       IsVisible="{Binding HasKindMarker}" />
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource Muted2Brush}"
                                       Text="{Binding SourceApp}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource Muted2Brush}" Text="{Binding Age}" />
                            <Button Classes="icon ghost" IsVisible="{Binding IsMultiline}"
                                    Command="{Binding ToggleExpandCommand}">
                              <Viewbox Width="11" Height="11">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconChevronDown}"
                                        Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}" StrokeThickness="2.4"
                                        StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                                        IsVisible="{Binding !IsExpanded}" />
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconChevronUp}"
                                        Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}" StrokeThickness="2.4"
                                        StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                                        IsVisible="{Binding IsExpanded}" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <Viewbox Width="13" Height="13" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                              <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                <Path Classes="copyGlyph" Data="{StaticResource IconCopy}"
                                      Stroke="{StaticResource MutedBrush}" StrokeThickness="2"
                                      StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                              </Grid>
                            </Viewbox>
                            <Border Classes="enterBadge"
                                    BorderBrush="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                                    CornerRadius="4" Padding="6,1" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                              <!-- one badge rather than two, so a row that cannot be run is
                                   not left with the gap where a second one would have sat -->
                              <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
                                         Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}"
                                         Text="{Binding EnterHint}" />
                            </Border>
                          </StackPanel>

                          <!-- hover: pin / save as snippet / delete / show / copy -->
                          <StackPanel Classes="hoverActions" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1"
                                      Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="4" Margin="12,0,0,0"
                                      VerticalAlignment="Center">
                            <Button Classes="icon"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).TogglePinCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconPin}" StrokeThickness="2"
                                        StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                                        Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                        IsVisible="{Binding !IsPinned}" />
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconPin}" StrokeThickness="2"
                                        StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                                        Stroke="{StaticResource AccentBrush}"
                                        IsVisible="{Binding IsPinned}" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <Button Classes="icon" IsVisible="{Binding !IsImage}"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).PromoteToSnippetCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconBookmark}" Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <Button Classes="icon"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).DeleteClipCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconTrash}" Stroke="{StaticResource DangerBrush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <!-- where a copied file is, or the path a copied line names -->
                            <Button Classes="icon" IsVisible="{Binding NamesAPath}"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).RevealCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconFolder}" Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                            <Button Classes="icon amber"
                                    Command="{Binding $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).CopyCommand}"
                                    CommandParameter="{Binding}">
                              <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12">
                                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconCopy}" Stroke="{StaticResource OnAccentBrush}"
                                        StrokeThickness="2.2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                                </Grid>
                              </Viewbox>
                            </Button>
                          </StackPanel>

                          <!-- expanded multi-line content -->
                          <Border Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="0" Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                                  IsVisible="{Binding IsExpanded}" Margin="0,7,0,0"
                                  Background="{StaticResource CodeBgBrush}"
                                  BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                                  CornerRadius="6" Padding="11,9">
                            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="11" LineHeight="17.6"
                                       Foreground="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                                       Text="{Binding Content}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                          </Border>
                        </Grid>
                      </Border>
                    </DockPanel>
                  </Border>
                </DataTemplate>
              </ListBox.DataTemplates>
            </ListBox>

            <!-- Drag to trade height between the list and the preview. Hidden with the
                 pane, so its Auto row collapses to nothing while the preview is closed. -->
            <GridSplitter x:Name="PreviewSplitter" Grid.Row="1"
                          Classes="previewSplitter"
                          ResizeDirection="Rows" ResizeBehavior="PreviousAndNext"
                          IsVisible="{Binding IsPreviewOpen}" />

            <!-- Preview pane: full content of the selected row. Collapsed by default;
                 toggled by its header, the footer link, or Ctrl/Cmd+P. -->
            <Border x:Name="PreviewPane" Grid.Row="2"
                    IsVisible="{Binding IsPreviewOpen}"
                    Background="{StaticResource CodeBgBrush}">
              <DockPanel>

                <!-- header doubles as the close affordance -->
                <Button DockPanel.Dock="Top" Classes="previewHeader" Focusable="False"
                        Command="{Binding TogglePreviewCommand}">
                  <DockPanel>
                    <Viewbox DockPanel.Dock="Right" Width="11" Height="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                             Margin="10,0,0,0">
                      <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
                        <Path Data="{StaticResource IconChevronDown}" Stroke="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                              StrokeThickness="2.4" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round" />
                      </Grid>
                    </Viewbox>
                    <TextBlock Classes="mono" DockPanel.Dock="Right" FontSize="10"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                               Text="{Binding PreviewKeyHint}" />
                    <TextBlock Classes="mono" DockPanel.Dock="Left" FontSize="10"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}" Text="preview" />
                    <TextBlock FontSize="11" FontWeight="SemiBold" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               Margin="0,0,10,0"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}"
                               Text="{Binding SelectedSnippet.Label}"
                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                  </DockPanel>
                </Button>

                <!-- empty state: nothing matches the filter -->
                <TextBlock Classes="mono" DockPanel.Dock="Top" FontSize="11" Margin="14,12"
                           Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                           Text="No snippet selected"
                           IsVisible="{Binding SelectedSnippet, Converter={x:Static ObjectConverters.IsNull}}" />

                <ScrollViewer Padding="14,10"
                              HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                              VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto"
                              IsVisible="{Binding SelectedSnippet, Converter={x:Static ObjectConverters.IsNotNull}}">
                  <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="11" LineHeight="17.6"
                             Foreground="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                             Text="{Binding SelectedSnippet.Content}" TextWrapping="Wrap" />
                </ScrollViewer>
              </DockPanel>
            </Border>
          </Grid>

        </DockPanel>

        <!-- Recent commands (the MRU). Newest first, filtered to what the search box
             could still become; ↑/↓ browse it and write the highlighted line into the
             box, so the row underneath already shows what Enter will do. -->
        <Border x:Name="CommandsPanel" VerticalAlignment="Top" Margin="14,0,14,0"
                IsVisible="{Binding IsCommandsOpen}"
                Background="{StaticResource SurfaceBrush}"
                BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderStrongBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
                CornerRadius="0,0,6,6" BoxShadow="0 8 24 #6612141A">
          <DockPanel>
            <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="10,6,10,5"
                    BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
              <DockPanel>
                <TextBlock Classes="mono" DockPanel.Dock="Right" FontSize="10"
                           Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                           Text="↑↓ browse · Del forget · Esc close" />
                <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
                           Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}" Text="recent" />
              </DockPanel>
            </Border>
            <ListBox x:Name="CommandsList" Classes="commands" MaxHeight="188"
                     ItemsSource="{Binding Commands}"
                     SelectedItem="{Binding SelectedCommand}"
                     AutoScrollToSelectedItem="True"
                     SelectionMode="Single">
              <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                <DataTemplate x:DataType="x:String">
                  <Border Background="Transparent" Padding="10,5" Tapped="CommandTapped">
                    <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="11" Text="{Binding}"
                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                  </Border>
                </DataTemplate>
              </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
            </ListBox>
          </DockPanel>
        </Border>
      </Panel>
    </DockPanel>

    <!-- Toast -->
    <Border Classes="toast" Classes.visible="{Binding IsToastVisible}"
            HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Margin="0,0,0,42">
      <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="7">
        <Viewbox Width="12" Height="12" VerticalAlignment="Center">
          <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
            <Path Data="{StaticResource IconCheck}" Stroke="{StaticResource AccentBrush}"
                  StrokeThickness="3" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                  IsVisible="{Binding !IsToastError}" />
            <Path Data="{StaticResource IconAlert}" Stroke="{StaticResource DangerBrush}"
                  StrokeThickness="2" StrokeLineCap="Round" StrokeJoin="Round"
                  IsVisible="{Binding IsToastError}" />
          </Grid>
        </Viewbox>
        <TextBlock Text="{Binding ToastText}" FontSize="11" MaxWidth="420"
                   TextWrapping="Wrap"
                   Foreground="{StaticResource TextPrimaryBrush}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
      </StackPanel>
    </Border>

    <!-- A chord half-pressed: the first key of a two-key snippet shortcut is down, and Klippy is waiting
         for the second — or the second led nowhere. Above the toast, so a copy's toast never covers it. -->
    <Border x:Name="ChordPill" Classes="toast" Classes.visible="{Binding HasChordStatus}"
            HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Bottom" Margin="0,0,0,80">
      <Panel>
        <TextBlock Classes="mono" Text="{Binding ChordStatus}" FontSize="11"
                   Foreground="{StaticResource AccentBrush}" IsVisible="{Binding !IsChordMiss}" />
        <TextBlock Classes="mono" Text="{Binding ChordStatus}" FontSize="11"
                   Foreground="{StaticResource DangerBrush}" IsVisible="{Binding IsChordMiss}" />
      </Panel>
    </Border>

    <views:EditorOverlay />
    <views:ConfirmOverlay />
    <views:OfferConfirmOverlay />
    <views:TransferOverlay />
    <views:SettingsOverlay />
  </Panel>
</Window>

1	<Window xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
2	        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
3	        xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
4	        xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
5	        xmlns:vm="using:Klippy.ViewModels"
6	        xmlns:views="using:Klippy.Views"
7	        mc:Ignorable="d" d:DesignWidth="680" d:DesignHeight="560"
8	        x:Class="Klippy.Views.MainWindow"
9	        x:DataType="vm:MainViewModel"
10	        Icon="/Assets/klippy.ico"
11	        Title="Klippy"

13	        MinWidth="460" MinHeight="360"

15	        ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint="True"
16	        ExtendClientAreaTitleBarHeightHint="34"

20	  <Panel>

25	        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6"
26	                    HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center">
27	          <TextBlock Text="Klippy" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold"
28	                     Foreground="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
29	                     VerticalAlignment="Center" />

31	                     Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
32	                     Text="{Binding VersionText}" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
33	        </StackPanel>
34	      </Border>
35	
36	      <!-- Footer: key hints + export/import + count -->
37	      <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Padding="14,8"
38	              BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0">
39	        <DockPanel>
40	          <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="12">
41	            <Button Classes="footerLink" Classes.on="{Binding IsPreviewOpen}"
42	                    Content="preview" Focusable="False"
43	                    Command="{Binding TogglePreviewCommand}" />
44	            <Button Classes="footerLink" Content="clear history"
45	                    IsVisible="{Binding IsHistoryMode}"
46	                    Command="{Binding ClearHistoryCommand}" />
47	            <Button Classes="footerLink" Content="export / import"
48	                    Command="{Binding OpenTransferCommand}" />
49	            <Button Classes="footerLink" Content="settings"
50	                    Command="{Binding OpenSettingsCommand}" />
51	            <Button Classes="footerLink" Content="quit"
52	                    Command="{Binding RequestQuitCommand}" />
53	            <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
54	                       Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
55	                       Text="{Binding SnippetCountText}" />
56	          </StackPanel>
57	          <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="10"
58	                     Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
59	                     Text="{Binding KeyHints}" />
60	        </DockPanel>
61	      </Border>
62	
63	      <!-- Filter bar -->
64	      <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Padding="14,12"
65	              BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1">
66	        <DockPanel>
67	          <Button DockPanel.Dock="Right" Classes="primary" Margin="10,0,0,0"
68	                  Command="{Binding NewCommand}">
69	            <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="6">
70	              <TextBlock Text="+" FontSize="14" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,-1,0,0" />
71	              <TextBlock Text="New" VerticalAlignment="Center" />
72	            </StackPanel>
73	          </Button>
74	          <Border Background="{StaticResource SurfaceBrush}"
75	                  BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderStrongBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
76	                  CornerRadius="6" Padding="10,7">
77	            <DockPanel>
78	              <Viewbox DockPanel.Dock="Left" Width="13" Height="13" Margin="0,0,8,0"
79	                       VerticalAlignment="Center">
80	                <Grid Width="24" Height="24">
81	                  <Path Data="{StaticResource IconSearch}" Stroke="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
82	                        StrokeThickness="2.4" StrokeLineCap="Round" />
83	                </Grid>

using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Input;
using Klippy.ViewModels;

namespace Klippy.Views;

public partial class ConfirmOverlay : UserControl
{
    public ConfirmOverlay()
    {
        InitializeComponent();
        ConfirmFocus.Attach(Overlay, CancelButton, ConfirmButton);
    }

    private void ScrimPressed(object? sender, PointerPressedEventArgs e)
    {

            vm.CancelDeleteCommand.Execute(null);

}
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

namespace Klippy.Services;

/// <summary>App preferences, kept separate from snippet data so an import can never clobber them.</summary>
public sealed class AppSettings
{
    /// <summary>Global hotkey that summons the window, e.g. "Ctrl+Alt+K".</summary>
    public string Hotkey { get; set; } = HotkeySpec.PlatformDefault;

    /// <summary>Set false to leave the key alone entirely.</summary>
    public bool HotkeyEnabled { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Global hotkey that summons the clipboard history, e.g. "Ctrl+Alt+J". Empty turns
    /// this one off while leaving the snippet hotkey alone.
    /// </summary>
    public string HistoryHotkey { get; set; } = HotkeySpec.HistoryPlatformDefault;

    /// <summary>The history hotkey, or null when it is switched off or unparseable.</summary>
    [JsonIgnore]
    public HotkeySpec? ParsedHistoryHotkey =>
        HotkeySpec.TryParse(HistoryHotkey, out var spec) ? spec : null;

    /// <summary>Whether to record what gets copied. Desktop only; ignored where the OS forbids capture.</summary>
    public bool HistoryEnabled { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>How many clips to keep before the oldest unpinned ones are dropped.</summary>
    public int HistoryLimit { get; set; } = ClipHistoryStore.DefaultCapacity;

    /// <summary>
    /// Keep history in memory only, so nothing copied is ever written to disk. The
    /// history is a record of everything that passed through the clipboard, and that is
    /// a thing a person is entitled to decline.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HistorySessionOnly { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Set false to leave screenshots and copied pictures out of the history.</summary>
    public bool HistoryCaptureImages { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>Set false to leave copied file selections out of the history.</summary>
    public bool HistoryCaptureFiles { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Largest picture worth keeping, in megabytes. Images are blobs on disk, so this is
    /// about not filling a drive with copies of whole screens.
    /// </summary>
    public int HistoryImageLimitMb { get; set; } = 16;

    /// <summary>
    /// Applications never recorded from, by process name ("keepass"). Password managers
    /// already mark their own clipboard writes and those are honoured regardless — this
    /// is for anything else the user would rather not have kept.
    /// </summary>
    public string[] HistoryExcludedApps { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();

    /// <summary>
    /// How many typed command lines the MRU keeps — the lines recalled with the down
    /// arrow. Zero turns it off and forgets the ones already recorded, which is the
    /// answer for anyone who would rather not have a written record of what they type.
    /// </summary>
    public int CommandHistoryLimit { get; set; } = CommandHistory.DefaultCapacity;

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether copying a Markdown snippet also puts an HTML flavour on the clipboard.
    /// Off makes a Markdown snippet copy as its raw source everywhere — what you want
    /// when the target is another Markdown editor rather than a rich-text box.
    /// </summary>
    public bool MarkdownToHtml { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether the HTML puts a blank line between blocks. On suits composers that strip
    /// paragraph margins (Zendesk), where the separation would otherwise vanish; off
    /// suits Outlook and Word, which honour those margins and so space it twice over.
    /// </summary>
    public bool MarkdownDoubleSpaced { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether the plain-text flavour of a Markdown snippet has its links reduced to bare
    /// URLs: <c>[www.qwe.com](https://www.qwe.com)</c> becomes <c>https://www.qwe.com</c>.
    /// For targets that only take plain text (the Zendesk mobile app), where the raw
    /// Markdown link syntax would otherwise land verbatim. The HTML flavour keeps its
    /// links intact, so rich-text targets lose nothing. Off by default: a Markdown editor
    /// wants the source as written.
    /// </summary>
    public bool MarkdownSanitiseLinks { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether copying a clip from the history dismisses the window. On by default: the
    /// history is a launcher gesture — summon, pick, paste — and leaving the window in
    /// front of the app you are pasting into just means dismissing it by hand.
    /// </summary>
    public bool CloseAfterClipboardCopy { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether copying a snippet dismisses the window. Off by default: snippets are
    /// browsed as much as they are used, and copying two in a row is ordinary.
    /// </summary>
    public bool CloseAfterSnippetCopy { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether running a script or an application first brings its folder up to date with
    /// <c>git pull</c>. Off by default: it only makes sense where the things you run are
    /// kept in a checkout, it costs a round trip to the remote on every run, and it is a
    /// network call made on your behalf — all three are things to opt into. A target that
    /// is not in a repository is left alone either way, and a pull that fails is reported
    /// rather than cancelling the run.
    /// </summary>
    public bool ExecutePullFirst { get; set; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether a search that matched nothing may be run instead: a URL, a folder, a
    /// program, or one of the OS controls. On by default — the offer only ever appears
    /// once the list is empty, and it takes a deliberate Enter on top of that.
    /// </summary>
    public bool ExecuteUnmatched { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether a path has to exist before it is offered. On by default: an offer to run
    /// something should mean there is something there. Off suits a network share that is
    /// slow to answer, or a path that only exists once something else has run — the OS
    /// then reports the failure instead.
    /// </summary>
    public bool ExecuteVerifyPaths { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Whether hibernate, sleep, lock and restart ask first. On by default: three of the
    /// four interrupt everything you are doing, and a launcher is a place where people
    /// type fast. Off makes a typed "lock" plus Enter lock the screen outright, which is
    /// the point of the setting.
    /// </summary>
    public bool ExecuteConfirmSystemActions { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>
    /// Kinds of file opened as documents, beyond the built-in pages, PDFs, pictures and
    /// macro-free Office files — <c>[".slnx", ".sln"]</c> for solutions that should open in
    /// the IDE their extension belongs to. Applies to an item marked Execute and to a
    /// variable typed by name, never to a path typed into the search box.
    ///
    /// Empty by default, and a list to add to rather than a switch, because opening a file
    /// is the same verb as running one to the shell: a <c>.js</c> or a <c>.lnk</c> opened
    /// is a program started, so which kinds are opened is a choice made one kind at a time.
    /// Settings keeps it under ALSO OPEN; a hand-written one is read as written.
    /// Scripts and applications are not affected by it either way — see
    /// <see cref="ExecutionPolicy.Opens"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public string[] ExecuteOpenExtensions { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Kinds of link opened beyond the built-in web, settings and browser pages —
    /// <c>["vscode:", "obsidian:"]</c> — each handed to whatever application registered
    /// its kind, as clicking one in a browser would. Applies where
    /// <see cref="ExecuteOpenExtensions"/> does, and is empty by default for the same
    /// reason: what an application does with a link is up to the application, so which
    /// kinds are opened is a choice made one kind at a time. Settings keeps these on the
    /// same ALSO OPEN list, told apart by their colon; here one may be written with or
    /// without it. A <c>file:</c> link is a path and never a kind to list — see
    /// <see cref="ExecutionPolicy.WhyNotOpenable"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public string[] ExecuteOpenSchemes { get; set; } = Array.Empty<string>();

    /// <summary>
    /// Both lists as the execution rules take them: the kinds of file as written, and the
    /// kinds of link each with its colon, which is how the rules tell one from the other.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonIgnore]
    public string[] AlsoOpens
    {
        get
        {
            var schemes = ExecuteOpenSchemes ?? [];
            var kinds = new List<string>((ExecuteOpenExtensions ?? []).Length + schemes.Length);
            kinds.AddRange(ExecuteOpenExtensions ?? []);
            foreach (var written in schemes)
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(written)
                    && (ExecutionPolicy.AsLinkKind(written) ?? ExecutionPolicy.AsLinkKind(written + ":")) is { } kind)
                    kinds.Add(kind);
            return [.. kinds];
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Where the window lands when a hotkey summons it: "Remembered", "Centre" or
    /// "Pointer". Remembered by default, and not only because an upgrade should change
    /// nothing: a resident launcher that always comes back to the same corner becomes
    /// muscle memory, and that is worth keeping as a choice rather than a fallback.
    ///
    /// A string rather than the enum itself, for the reason the hotkeys are strings — one
    /// typo in a hand-edited file must cost this preference and nothing else.
    /// </summary>
    public string SummonPlacement { get; set; } = nameof(LauncherPlacement.Remembered);

    /// <summary>
    /// The folder the snippets and the variables file live in, unless those name a path
    /// of their own. Empty means the platform's own app-data folder, which is what it has
    /// always been. Environment variables and a leading <c>~</c> are expanded, so
    /// <c>"%OneDrive%\\Klippy"</c> is a legitimate way to write it.
    ///
    /// Not the clipboard history, the command MRU or the clip images: those are the
    /// record of what happened on this machine and stay beside settings.json, because
    /// this is a setting people point at a synced drive and a log of everything copied
    /// must not follow the snippets there as a side effect of moving them.
    ///
    /// Read once at startup, since a store that changed folder mid-session would have to
    /// decide what to do with the file it already had open. Nothing is moved for you:
    /// copy the files across first, and note that the old folder is left exactly as it
    /// was, so setting this back gets you back.
    ///
    /// settings.json itself never moves — it is the file that says where everything else
    /// went, so it stays where Klippy can always find it.
    /// </summary>
    public string DataDirectory { get; set; } = "";

    /// <summary>
    /// The snippet store. Empty is <c>snippets.json</c> in <see cref="DataDirectory"/>,
    /// which is what it has always been; a bare name is another file in that folder; an
    /// absolute path is taken as given, and is the point of the setting — the snippets
    /// can sit in a synced folder while everything about *this* machine stays on it.
    ///
    /// It and <see cref="VariablesFile"/> are the only two files worth pointing
    /// anywhere. The history and the command MRU are records of what happened here, so
    /// they stay in the folder above; settings.json is the note saying where the
    /// snippets went, so it cannot follow them.
    ///
    /// Read once at startup, for the reason <see cref="DataDirectory"/> is, and nothing
    /// is moved for you either: copy the file across first, and the old one is left
    /// exactly where it was, so setting this back gets you back.
    /// </summary>
    public string SnippetsFile { get; set; } = "";

    /// <summary>
    /// The local variables file: <c>%name%</c> defines an item expands on the way to the
    /// clipboard, and that the run path resolves a path against. Empty is
    /// <c>variables.txt</c> in <see cref="DataDirectory"/>; a bare name sits beside the
    /// snippets, and an absolute path is taken as given — which is how a snippet store
    /// shared between two machines still reads a file local to each.
    ///
    /// The one file here that is re-read as it changes rather than at startup: it is
    /// hand-edited, and "restart Klippy" is a poor answer to a typo.
    /// </summary>
    public string VariablesFile { get; set; } = "";

    /// <summary>
    /// The one instance the app reads and writes. Loaded on first touch, because the
    /// shared UI needs preferences on platforms whose head never loads them itself
    /// (Android, iOS) — and where there is no settings.json a user could edit by hand.
    /// </summary>
    public static AppSettings Current
    {
        get => _current ??= Load();
        set => _current = value;
    }

    private static AppSettings? _current;

    [JsonIgnore]
    public HotkeySpec ParsedHotkey =>
        HotkeySpec.TryParse(Hotkey, out var spec) ? spec : HotkeySpec.Default;

    /// <summary>The placement, or Remembered when the value is missing or unreadable.</summary>
    [JsonIgnore]
    public LauncherPlacement ParsedSummonPlacement => PlacementPolicy.Parse(SummonPlacement);

    public static string FilePath => StorageLocations.SettingsPath;

    /// <summary>
    /// Where this instance came from, and where <see cref="Save"/> writes back. Carried on
    /// the instance so a caller that loaded from somewhere else — a test, mostly — cannot
    /// have its writes land on the real settings file.
    /// </summary>
    [JsonIgnore]
    public string SourcePath { get; set; } = FilePath;

    /// <summary>Never throws: unreadable settings fall back to defaults.</summary>
    public static AppSettings Load(string? path = null)
    {
        path ??= FilePath;
        try
        {
            if (File.Exists(path))
            {
                using var stream = File.OpenRead(path);
                if (JsonSerializer.Deserialize(stream, SettingsJsonContext.Default.AppSettings) is { } loaded)
                {
                    loaded.SourcePath = path;
                    return loaded;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // fall through to defaults
        }
        return new AppSettings { SourcePath = path };
    }

    public void Save(string? path = null)
    {
        path ??= SourcePath;
        var dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(path);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dir)) Directory.CreateDirectory(dir);

        var tmp = path + ".tmp";
        using (var stream = File.Create(tmp))
            JsonSerializer.Serialize(stream, this, SettingsJsonContext.Default.AppSettings);
        AtomicFile.Replace(tmp, path);
    }
}

[JsonSourceGenerationOptions(WriteIndented = true)]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(AppSettings))]
public sealed partial class SettingsJsonContext : JsonSerializerContext;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Security.Cryptography;

namespace Klippy.Services;

/// <summary>
/// Where image bytes live.
///
/// Kept out of <c>clipboard.history.json</c> because the store rewrites that file whole on every
/// flush: megabytes of base64 in it would make each copy cost the entire history. A blob
/// per image, deleted when its clip is, keeps the JSON small and the writes cheap.
/// </summary>
public interface IClipBlobStore
{
    void Save(string name, byte[] bytes);

    /// <summary>Null when the blob is missing — a hand-deleted file, or an interrupted write.</summary>
    byte[]? TryLoad(string name);

    void Delete(string name);
}

/// <summary>Blobs as files in their own directory beside the history JSON.</summary>
public sealed class FileClipBlobStore : IClipBlobStore
{
    private readonly string _directory;

    public FileClipBlobStore(string directory) => _directory = directory;

    public void Save(string name, byte[] bytes)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(_directory);

        // Written through a temp file for the same reason the JSON is: a half-written
        // blob that a later run tries to put on the clipboard is worse than none.
        var path = Path.Combine(_directory, name);
        var tmp = path + ".tmp";
        File.WriteAllBytes(tmp, bytes);
        AtomicFile.Replace(tmp, path);
    }

    public byte[]? TryLoad(string name)
    {
        try
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(_directory, name);
            return File.Exists(path) ? File.ReadAllBytes(path) : null;
        }
        catch (IOException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public void Delete(string name)
    {
        try
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(_directory, name);
            if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path);
        }
        catch (IOException)
        {
            // A blob that outlives its clip is litter, not a failure worth surfacing.
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>Blobs held in memory, for session-only history.</summary>
public sealed class MemoryClipBlobStore : IClipBlobStore
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, byte[]> _blobs = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public void Save(string name, byte[] bytes) => _blobs[name] = bytes;

    public byte[]? TryLoad(string name) => _blobs.TryGetValue(name, out var bytes) ? bytes : null;

    public void Delete(string name) => _blobs.Remove(name);
}

public static class ClipBlobs
{
    /// <summary>Directory name for blobs, a sibling of the history file.</summary>
    public const string DirectoryName = "clips";

    /// <summary>Content hash, used to recognise the same picture copied twice.</summary>

    /// <summary>Blob file name for a clip: the id, so a stray blob is traceable to its entry.</summary>
    public static string FileName(Guid id, string format) =>
        $"{id:N}.{(format.Length > 0 ? format.ToLowerInvariant() : "bin")}";

    public ClipHistoryStore(string? filePath = null, int capacity = DefaultCapacity)

/// Where image bytes live.
///
/// Kept out of <c>clipboard.history.json</c> because the store rewrites that file whole on every

public interface IClipBlobStore
{
    void Save(string name, byte[] bytes);

    /// <summary>Null when the blob is missing — a hand-deleted file, or an interrupted write.</summary>
    byte[]? TryLoad(string name);

/// <summary>Blobs as files in their own directory beside the history JSON.</summary>
public sealed class FileClipBlobStore : IClipBlobStore
{
    private readonly string _directory;

    public FileClipBlobStore(string directory) => _directory = directory;

    public void Save(string name, byte[] bytes)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(_directory);

        // Written through a temp file for the same reason the JSON is: a half-written
        // blob that a later run tries to put on the clipboard is worse than none.
        var path = Path.Combine(_directory, name);
        var tmp = path + ".tmp";
        File.WriteAllBytes(tmp, bytes);
        AtomicFile.Replace(tmp, path);
    }

    public byte[]? TryLoad(string name)
    {
        try
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(_directory, name);
            return File.Exists(path) ? File.ReadAllBytes(path) : null;
        }
        catch (IOException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public void Delete(string name)
    {
        try
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(_directory, name);
            if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path);
        }
        catch (IOException)
        {
            // A blob that outlives its clip is litter, not a failure worth surfacing.
        }
    }
}

<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:vm="using:Klippy.ViewModels"
             xmlns:svc="using:Klippy.Services"
             x:Class="Klippy.Views.SettingsOverlay"
             x:DataType="vm:MainViewModel">

  <Panel IsVisible="{Binding Settings, Converter={x:Static ObjectConverters.IsNotNull}}">
    <Border Background="{StaticResource ScrimBrush}" PointerPressed="ScrimPressed" />

    <!-- Outside the panel rather than inside it: a ScrollViewer measures its content with
         no height limit, so the panel is centred whole while it fits and scrolls once it
         does not. Without this the "Done" button falls off the bottom of a short window,
         and the list of preferences only ever grows. It covers the scrim, so it carries the
         same handler — which is why that one has to tell a press beside the panel from one
         inside it. -->
    <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled"
                  PointerPressed="ScrimPressed">
      <Border x:Name="Panel" MaxWidth="460" Margin="20" VerticalAlignment="Center"
              Background="{StaticResource SurfaceBrush}"
              BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderStrongBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
              CornerRadius="8" Padding="16">
        <ContentControl Content="{Binding Settings}">
          <ContentControl.ContentTemplate>
            <DataTemplate x:DataType="vm:SettingsViewModel">
              <StackPanel Spacing="12">
                <TextBlock Text="Settings" FontSize="13" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                           Foreground="{StaticResource TextPrimaryBrush}" />

                <StackPanel Spacing="8">
                  <TextBlock Classes="mono" Text="MARKDOWN" FontSize="10" LetterSpacing="0.8"
                             Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}" />

                  <!-- Grid, not a horizontal StackPanel: the star column is what gives the
                       explanation a width to wrap inside. -->
                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,8,*">
                    <ToggleButton Grid.Column="0" Classes="chip" Content="Rich text"
                                  VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                  IsChecked="{Binding MarkdownToHtml}" />
                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" FontSize="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                               Text="Copy Markdown snippets as formatted HTML too. Off copies the raw Markdown everywhere." />
                  </Grid>

                  <!-- Only means anything while there is HTML to space out. -->
                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,8,*" IsEnabled="{Binding MarkdownToHtml}">
                    <ToggleButton Grid.Column="0" Classes="chip" Content="Double spacing"
                                  VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                  IsChecked="{Binding MarkdownDoubleSpaced}" />
                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" FontSize="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                               Text="Blank line between paragraphs. On for helpdesk composers, off for Outlook and Word." />
                  </Grid>

                  <!-- Plain-text flavour only, so it stays enabled whatever Rich text says. -->
                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,8,*">
                    <ToggleButton Grid.Column="0" Classes="chip" Content="Bare links"
                                  VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                  IsChecked="{Binding MarkdownSanitiseLinks}" />
                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" FontSize="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                               Text="In the plain-text copy, [text](url) becomes just the URL. For apps that paste as plain text, like Zendesk on mobile." />
                  </Grid>
                </StackPanel>

                <Border Height="1" Background="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}"
                        IsVisible="{Binding ShowCloseAfterCopy}" />

                <StackPanel Spacing="8" IsVisible="{Binding ShowCloseAfterCopy}">
                  <TextBlock Classes="mono" Text="AFTER COPY" FontSize="10" LetterSpacing="0.8"
                             Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}" />

                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,8,*">
                    <ToggleButton Grid.Column="0" Classes="chip" Content="Close on clip"
                                  VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                  IsChecked="{Binding CloseAfterClipboardCopy}" />
                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" FontSize="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                               Text="Copying from the clipboard history dismisses Klippy, ready to paste." />
                  </Grid>

                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,8,*">
                    <ToggleButton Grid.Column="0" Classes="chip" Content="Close on snippet"
                                  VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                  IsChecked="{Binding CloseAfterSnippetCopy}" />
                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" FontSize="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                               Text="Copying a snippet dismisses Klippy too. Off leaves the list up for the next one." />
                  </Grid>
                </StackPanel>

                <Border Height="1" Background="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}"
                        IsVisible="{Binding ShowExecutePullFirst}" />

                <StackPanel Spacing="8" IsVisible="{Binding ShowExecutePullFirst}">
                  <TextBlock Classes="mono" Text="WHEN RUNNING" FontSize="10" LetterSpacing="0.8"
                             Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}" />

                  <Grid ColumnDefinitions="Auto,8,*">
                    <ToggleButton Grid.Column="0" Classes="chip" Content="Pull first"
                                  VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                  IsChecked="{Binding ExecutePullFirst}" />
                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" FontSize="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               TextWrapping="Wrap"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}"
                               Text="Run git pull in a script or application's own folder before starting it, so what runs is what is in the repository. Skipped where it is not a checkout." />
                  </Grid>

                  <!-- The kinds of file and of link opened beyond the built-in ones. A chip
                       per kind, which a click takes off; the box below adds one, a link's
                       kind written with its colon. Opening a kind of file can be running
                       it, and a link is whatever its application makes of it, so each is
                       added on purpose. -->
                  <StackPanel x:Name="OpenKindsRow" Spacing="6" Margin="0,4,0,0">
                    <TextBlock Classes="mono" Text="ALSO OPEN" FontSize="10" LetterSpacing="0.8"
                               Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}" />
                    <TextBlock FontSize="11" TextWrapping="Wrap"

                    <ItemsControl ItemsSource="{Binding OpenKinds}"
                                  IsVisible="{Binding HasOpenKinds}">
                      <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                        <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                          <WrapPanel />

<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             xmlns:vm="using:Klippy.ViewModels"
             x:Class="Klippy.Views.ImagePreviewOverlay"
             x:DataType="vm:MainViewModel">

  <!-- An image clip full size, inside Klippy: the row's thumbnail is enough to recognise a
       picture, not to read one. Fills the window less a margin, the picture scaled down to
       fit and never up, so a small icon stays crisp rather than turning to mush. -->
  <Panel x:Name="Overlay"
         IsVisible="{Binding ImagePreview, Converter={x:Static ObjectConverters.IsNotNull}}">
    <Border Background="{StaticResource ScrimBrush}" PointerPressed="ScrimPressed" />

    <Border Margin="20"
            Background="{StaticResource SurfaceBrush}"
            BorderBrush="{StaticResource BorderStrongBrush}" BorderThickness="1"
            CornerRadius="8" Padding="12">
      <DockPanel>
        <DockPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Margin="2,0,0,10">
          <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Right" Classes="mono" FontSize="10" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                     Foreground="{StaticResource MutedBrush}" Text="Esc close" />
          <TextBlock Classes="mono" FontSize="11" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                     Foreground="{StaticResource Muted3Brush}"
                     Text="{Binding ImagePreview.Label}" TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
        </DockPanel>

        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Orientation="Horizontal" Spacing="8"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,10,0,0">
          <Button x:Name="ShowButton" Classes="subtle" Content="Save & show in folder"
                  Command="{Binding SaveImageAndShowCommand}"
                  CommandParameter="{Binding ImagePreview}" />
          <Button Classes="subtle" Content="Save & copy path"
                  Command="{Binding SaveImageAndCopyPathCommand}"
                  CommandParameter="{Binding ImagePreview}" />
          <Button Classes="subtle" Content="Close"
                  Command="{Binding CloseImagePreviewCommand}" />
          <Button x:Name="CopyButton" Classes="primary" Content="Copy image"
                  Command="{Binding CopyPreviewedImageCommand}" />
        </StackPanel>

        <Border Background="{StaticResource CodeBgBrush}" CornerRadius="6"
                BorderBrush="{StaticResource HairlineBrush}" BorderThickness="1" ClipToBounds="True">
          <Image Source="{Binding ImagePreviewBitmap}" Margin="8"
                 Stretch="Uniform" StretchDirection="DownOnly" />
        </Border>
      </DockPanel>
    </Border>
  </Panel>
</UserControl>
